title.en: An Act Converting the Land Transportation Office (LTO) Extension Office Located in the Island Garden City of Samal, Province of Davao Del Norte Into a Regular LTO District Office, Appropriating Funds Therefor and for Other Purposes
title.orig: An Act Converting the Land Transportation Office (LTO) Extension Office Located in the Island Garden City of Samal, Province of Davao Del Norte Into a Regular LTO District Office, Appropriating Funds Therefor and for Other Purposes
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Văn phòng mở rộng Land Transportation Office thành Văn phòng Khu vực Regular LTO tại Thành phố Vườn Đảo Samal, Tỉnh Davao Del Norte, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này, và cho các mục đích khác
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะสำนักงานขยาย Land Transportation Office เป็น สำนักงานเขต Regular LTO ในเมืองสวนเกาะ Samal จังหวัด Davao Del Norte และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้ และเพื่อวัตถุประสงค์อื่น
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah status Kantor Perluasan Land Transportation Office menjadi Kantor Distrik Regular LTO di Kota Taman Pulau Samal, Provinsi Davao Del Norte, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu, dan untuk tujuan lain
title.ms: Akta menukar status Pejabat Lanjutan Land Transportation Office kepada Pejabat Daerah Regular LTO di Bandar Taman Pulau Samal, Wilayah Davao Del Norte, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu, dan untuk tujuan lain

text.en: The existing Land Transportation Office (LTO) Extension Office located in the Island Garden City of Samal, Province of Davao del Norte is hereby converted into a regular LTO District Office.
The Secretary of the Department of Transportation and Communications shall issue rules and regulations necessary for the effective implementation of this Act.

The Secretary of Transportation and Communications shall immediately include in the Department’s programs the operationalization of the LTO District Office in the Island Garden City of Samal, Province of Davao del Norte, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriations of the Island Garden City of Samal LTO Extension Office. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the continued implementation of this Act shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days following the completion of its publication in the Official Gazette or in two (2) national newspapers of general circulation.
